from hub import port, motion_sensor
import motor_pair, motor, sys, time
from app import linegraph

direction = 1

motor_pair.pair(motor_pair.PAIR_1, port.B, port.A)
Kp = 1.5        # Proportional constant
linegraph.clear_all()

def moveForDistance(distance):
    motor.reset_relative_position(port.A,0)
    heading = motion_sensor.tilt_angles()[0]            # Heading at the Beginning
    degrees_per_centimeter = 360 / 27.5
    degrees = distance * degrees_per_centimeter * direction        # total degrees the motors have to turn
    speed = 0
    i = 0
    if (degrees > 0):                                # basically "if you want the robot to move forward, then"
        while motor.relative_position(port.A) < degrees:
            speed += 100
            motor_pair.move(motor_pair.PAIR_1, round((motion_sensor.tilt_angles()[0] - heading) / 10 * (100 / 180) * Kp), velocity = speed)
            if motor.relative_position(port.A) < degrees / 2:                                   # accelerate till half of the distance is reached
                #speed = round(motor.relative_position(port.A) / degrees * 2 * 1050)            # 1050 because max speed for large motors
                speed = motor.relative_position(port.A) / degrees                               # calculate the percentage of the distance driven, value from 0 (start) to 0.5 (half of the distance)
                speed = speed * 2                                                               # multiply by 2 to get value from 0 (start) to 1 (half of the diastance)
                i += 1
            else:
                speed = round(((-(motor.relative_position(port.A) - degrees)) / degrees) * 1050)
                #speed = -round(motor.relative_position(port.A) / degrees * 2 * 1050)
                i += 1
            linegraph.plot(2,i,speed)
    else:
        while motor.relative_position(port.A) > degrees:
            speed += 100
            motor_pair.move(motor_pair.PAIR_1, round((heading - motion_sensor.tilt_angles()[0]) / 10 * (100 / 180) * Kp), velocity = -speed)
            if motor.relative_position(port.A) < degrees / 2:
                speed = round(motor.relative_position(port.A) / -(degrees) * 2 * 1050)            # 1050 because max speed for large motors
                i += 1
            else:
                speed = round(((-(motor.relative_position(port.A) + degrees)) / (-degrees)) * 1050)
                i += 1
            linegraph.plot(2,i,speed)

    motor_pair.stop(0)
    time.sleep_ms(5)

moveForDistance(100)
#moveForDistance(-100)
sys.exit()
